scientific_integrity: Sources credited for necessary obstructions, two-lucky base words, stability, and previous narrow three-lucky family. No claims of independent certification or universal three-lucky classification.
scientific_limitations: Only parity-mixed and odd-containing triples have necessary-and-sufficient criterion. Both-even theorem is sufficient only; private/unindexed priority remains possible. Finite verification to n8 exhaustive and n60 constructive; infinite result by proof. No independent audit.
title: Parity-complete three-lucky sets of Stirling permutations and a mixed-even construction
